adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the current `@embedding` (an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`) without reading params or persisting anything (`app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:8-10`). A PUT route is added for it (`config/routes.rb` adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`). This makes the update endpoint effectively meaningless/misleading (200 OK but no changes applied), even though the current UI appears to manage hosts via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` instead.
